message: There is not enough recorded yet to give a score. The areas below say what each one needs.

dimensions.label: Income consistency
dimensions.about: How steady your income is from month to month. Swing means how far a typical month is from your average month. A full score needs a swing of 15% or less; the score is zero at 100% or more.
dimensions.needed: Record your first payment. This area needs at least 3 full months since your first payment.
steps: Record the payments you have received on the Payments page, or import them from a CSV file.

dimensions.label: Profit margin
dimensions.about: How much of what you earn is left after the business expenses you recorded. A full score needs 60% or more left; the score is zero at 0% or less. Only expenses recorded in LanceraOS count. Personal spending and savings are not tracked here.
dimensions.needed: This needs income in the last 12 months.

dimensions.label: Tax compliance
dimensions.about: Whether your tax basics are in place: an NTN saved (8 points), PSEB registration marked (4 points), a payment recorded in the last 90 days (4 points) and an expense recorded in the last 90 days (4 points). The NTN and PSEB are what you entered; LanceraOS does not check them with FBR or PSEB. PSEB registration is for people who export IT services, so it may not apply to your work.
dimensions.needed: To score higher, complete the missing checks: NTN saved; PSEB registration marked; Payment recorded in the last 90 days; Expense recorded in the last 90 days.
steps: Save your NTN in Settings, then Tax & PSEB. An NTN is the number you need to file a tax return with FBR.
If you are registered with PSEB, mark it in Settings, then Tax & PSEB. PSEB registration is for people who export IT services, so it may not apply to your work.
No payment is recorded in the last 90 days. Record the money you have received on the Payments page.
No expense is recorded in the last 90 days. Record your business costs on the Expenses page, so your profit is not overstated.

checks.label: Payment recorded in the last 90 days
Expense recorded in the last 90 days

dimensions.label: Income growth
dimensions.about: How your average month compares with your average month in the same number of months before it. A full score needs growth of 30% or more, flat income earns half the points, and a fall of 30% or more scores zero.
dimensions.needed: This compares your last 12 months with the 12 months before them, and needs at least 3 of those earlier months on record. You have 0 months.

dimensions.label: Client diversity
dimensions.about: How much of your income depends on one payer, using the "Received from" name on your payments. A full score needs your biggest payer to be 30% or less of your named income; the score is zero at 80% or more. This needs a name on at least 70% of your income.
dimensions.needed: This needs income in the last 12 months.

tips.text: Record the payments you have received on the Payments page, or import them from a CSV file.
Save your NTN in Settings, then Tax & PSEB. An NTN is the number you need to file a tax return with FBR.
If you are registered with PSEB, mark it in Settings, then Tax & PSEB. PSEB registration is for people who export IT services, so it may not apply to your work.
No payment is recorded in the last 90 days. Record the money you have received on the Payments page.
No expense is recorded in the last 90 days. Record your business costs on the Expenses page, so your profit is not overstated.

notes: Only full calendar months are counted, so the current month is left out until it ends.
This score is a guide based on the records you keep in LanceraOS. It is not financial, accounting or tax advice.
